changed: On iPhone and iPad, Add figures from text ▸ From an image… and Import ▸ Dance code from a picture… now open your photos, so a photo or screenshot can be chosen straight from your library. The app doesn't ask for access to your photo library and receives only the picture you choose; its copy is deleted once read. A picture kept in the Files app needs saving to Photos first.
fixed: The picture type in the file dialog of From an image… and Dance code from a picture… on Windows and Linux is now named in the app's language, not always in English.
